jsonld_products.name: EverSweet Solo 2 Pet Water Fountain
jsonld_products.description:
[Wireless Pump Pet Water fountain] PETKIT EVERSWEET SOLO 2 comes out with an upgraded wireless pump 3.0, anti-dry-burning, longer lifetime, easy to assemble, and extremely quiet(Lower than 20dB).


[APP Control via Bluetooth] You can check the status of the water fountain through PETKIT app at any time, app will remind you when the water level is low.
[Ultra Safe] There are no wires on the water pump and fountain body, only one USB power cable on the base. But the base and the water fountain body can be separated, making operation safer and easier. (USB Power Adapter not included, you will need a 5V 1A power adapter/plug.)
[Detachable Design] With the detachable water fountain body and base, You won't get the charging base wet when topping up water or cleaning up the fountain.
[Multi-Layer Filtration System] It filters hair and dust and removes odor and heavy metals.
[3 Working Modes] Smart Mode, Normal Mode and Night Mode are applied to different conditions.
Capacity: 2L, meets your pets' water intake.
[Kindly Reminder] We recommend that you dismantle and clean the pump regularly, this will extend the life of the pump and water dispenser. And a thorough cleaning of the water pump can help you with the following problems: 1, weakened or no water coming out of the pump; 2, the pump becomes noisy.
